one_liner: Loud, hyper-energetic 'runaway' who follows the 'Voice of Fate' and drags everyone toward happiness.
personality: Boundlessly enthusiastic and impulsive: everything is 'fate', she wants to do it NOW, and she declares her intuition (the 『運命の声』, 'Voice of Fate') guides her. Generous and good at seeing others' best points, she wants to see her trainer's best smile and lead others rather than rule them. Her huge footsteps and volume are a running gag (she once woke the whole dorm).

story_arc.summary: Released as a playable trainee in Aug 2026 (5.5th anniversary). Her chapters are all 'Voice of Fate' titles (Hear it! Ring it! Believe it! Go with it!...). Career goals run Hopeful S, Satsuki Sho, Japan Derby, Kikka-sho, Osaka Hai, Takarazuka Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup and Arima Kinen; post-race titles hint she stumbles at the Satsuki Sho ('あれ！？', 'a friend's back'), rages after the Derby, gets a 'perfect fate' at the Kikka-sho and asks 'can you hear the voice?' in her senior year, then the Japan Cup ('let's go together with fate') and finally the Arima Kinen ('Chase this light!'). Dialogue specifics not verified.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://www.inside-games.jp/article/2026/08/22/186607.html (release info); real-race parallels general knowledge (unverified)
